title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 3 Game Selection + Matchup Handoff
scope: Consume the frozen Step 2 verified Sunday schedule, let the user select one verified matchup, persist that selection, and expose a clean handoff payload for future Page 2 work. No roster, player prop, sportsbook odds, projection, Passing Yards, or existing NFL market changes.

selection_contract.fail_closed_rule: If Step 2 supplies no verified game, Step 3 emits no handoff and renders a not-ready state.

acceptance: Only Step 2 VERIFIED games are selectable.
Selection survives Streamlit reruns through session state and supports ks_pa_game deep-link continuity.
A ready handoff includes matchup identity, schedule date, kickoff, week, network, venue, provider game id, and source provenance.
No verified games produces a fail-closed not-ready handoff.
Step 2 schedule module and ledger remain byte-identical.
Step 1 route owner remains active and Step 2 schedule remains publicly visible.
Frozen Passing Yards/router/app files remain byte-identical.
390/768/1440 Step 3 selected-matchup card has no horizontal overflow.
Changing the game picker updates the selected-game marker and handoff payload.
Public production proof passes before Step 3 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
